verdict.rationale: Decagon is an AI customer-support agent platform, so grounding answers in a customer's own content with source attribution is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents neither part. The closest item, Suggestions detecting knowledge gaps and drafting help-center content, is an adjacent content-authoring feature. It does not show that answers are grounded in that content or display the article they drew from.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every answer is grounded in my own content and shows which article or source it drew from
